mount_correction.why_not_applied: r3-calfix offline check (frames/calib-20261122-013512 + calibration/wrist_pose_0122): the mount alone moves the wrist-FK arm base from 57 mm to 347 mm off the foot; it only helps together with pitch-chain offsets (j2+j3+j4+j6 = +6.9 +- 1.4 deg), whose split over joints one pose cannot determine (full twinfix set 35 mm, an arbitrary j2/j6 split 16 mm; fitted on the same pose). Needs the 5-6 hand-moved wrist poses before it is applied.
